name: Aria Argent
original_name: アリア　アルジェント
source:
A prostitute (formerly) who played the role of temporary Santa. She has now become a proper Santa for the first time.

With her Santa sack (from which anything can come out) and Santa's license (one of a kind), she runs through the town on Holy Night with her reindeer.

She has snow-white skin, large breasts and big hips, and her erotic body is her weapon. She is better at handing out naughty gifts(?) or rather, she likes to do so.

The style of her bare skin, red coat and hat is the same as last time. The only problem is that the reindeer complained about it, so she's wearing panties.

[From [url=http://www.complets.co.jp/authoringheaven/sayyah2003.html]official site[/url]]
